_comment: `multipliers` are structural — they follow from how prompt caching is billed,
not from any one model's price sheet — so they rarely need touching.
`inputPerMTok` is USD per million INPUT tokens and starts null on purpose:
a stale hardcoded price silently corrupts every dollar figure, while a
missing one makes the report fall back to input-equivalent units, which are
exact. Fill it in from https://claude.com/pricing to see dollars.
`charsPerToken` is used ONLY to turn suppressed byte counts into an estimated
token count. Nothing in the absolute accounting depends on it.
